# Last Turn (Kero's): what an agent changed in its latest turn, and only
# that, not what was edited before it began (tests/run.sh makes the
# repository at @REPO@: a commit, then other.txt edited before the turn).
# Claude Code's prompt hook starts the turn: it takes the snapshot itself,
# before the agent edits anything. The turn edits app.txt, makes new.txt,
# and renames list.txt to moved.txt with a line more.
size:1280x800
wait:0.5
type:cd @REPO@ && printf '{"cwd":"%s"}' "$PWD" | libertty +agent-hook claude UserPromptSubmit && printf 'turn line\n' >> app.txt && printf 'made\n' > new.txt && mv list.txt moved.txt && printf 'seven\n' >> moved.txt && printf '\033]7501;state=done:app=claude-code\a'
key:enter
wait:3.0
action:open_git
wait:1.0
page-wait:go
page-click:Last Turn
wait:1.2
expect-page:turn began
expect-page:new.txt
expect-page:turn line
expect-page:moved.txt
expect-page-not:other.txt
# Keep hides a change (app.txt's, the first).
page-click:Keep
wait:0.4
expect-page-not:turn line
expect-shell:grep -c 'turn line' @REPO@/app.txt ==> 1
# Revert on moved.txt's line takes the line out and leaves the file where
# the turn moved it: no rename back to list.txt.
page-click:Revert
wait:1.2
expect-shell:cd @REPO@ && test -e moved.txt && test ! -e list.txt && echo still-moved ==> still-moved
expect-shell:grep -q seven @REPO@/moved.txt && echo kept || echo taken-out ==> taken-out
# Revert puts new.txt back as the turn found it: not there.
page-click:Revert
wait:1.2
expect-shell:test -e @REPO@/new.txt || echo gone ==> gone
# What's left is moved.txt's rename, with no lines to revert.
expect-page-not:new.txt
expect-page:moved.txt
# Uncommitted still shows everything since the commit.
page-click:Uncommitted
wait:0.8
expect-page:other.txt
